recordCorrections.addendaHint: A saved record is never changed. If something in it is wrong or missing, add a correction. It is dated, carries your name, and everyone who can see this record can read it.
recordCorrections.addendaEmpty: No corrections have been added to this record.
recordCorrections.addendumPlaceholder: For example: the dose was 2 ml, not 5 ml
recordCorrections.addendumSaved: Your correction was added under the record.
recordCorrections.mistakeExplainVaccination: This vaccination stays in the history, marked as a mistake, with your name and reason. It no longer counts in the passport, the compliance figures, the reminders or the certificates. If it covered a scheduled dose, that dose is due again.
recordCorrections.mistakeExplainAllergy: This allergy stays in the history, marked as a mistake, with your name and reason. It is no longer shown as an active allergy or used in warnings.
recordCorrections.reasonPlaceholder: For example: wrong animal, or wrong date
recordCorrections.waiveExplain: The plan stays on the passport, shown as skipped, with your reason. Doses not yet given are no longer asked for.
recordCorrections.waiveReason: Why is this plan being skipped?
recordCorrections.waiveReasonPlaceholder: For example: not needed on this farm, or the vet advised against it
recordCorrections.waived: Plan skipped. The passport shows it as skipped, with your reason.

errors.REC_NOT_AUTHOR: Only the person who entered this, the animal's owner, their farm team or an admin can mark it as entered by mistake. You can add a correction to the record instead, or ask one of them.
errors.generic: This could not be saved, so nothing was changed. Please try again.
